title: ChatGPT se anime selfie sirf 30 second me
description: India me 1 billion AI photos ban gayi hain. Tumhari abhi tak kyu nahi? Yeh trick aaj try karo.
voice: Ruko... India me ek billion AI photos ban gayi hain, aur tumhari abhi tak nahi? ChatGPT kholo, apni selfie upload karo. Ek line likho - turn this into a Studio Ghibli style anime portrait. Bas... 30 second me result tumhari screen pe hoga. Cinematic chahiye? 90s Bollywood poster chahiye? Sirf prompt change karo. Yeh trend India me viral ho raha hai. AI Tadka follow karke roz ek naya AI hack pao.
